en.headline: WestK Art Park opens LEGO Hero-ween event for children
en.dek: The free programme runs until 31 October and invites young visitors in costume to complete brick-building challenges and a final mission on Halloween night.
body: The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority and LEGO Hong Kong have opened a free Halloween-themed programme at the Art Park, running from 15 to 31 October.

Organisers describe a mischievous “Brick-Monster” that has appeared in the Secret Garden area. Children are invited to wear their favourite hero costumes, bring creative LEGO pieces, and take part in themed installations, a BRICK or TRICK workshop, a Hero Hunt, hands-on building activities and performances.

The programme culminates on 31 October with a grand celebration in which participants complete missions together. Those who finish the final challenge can receive a voucher for a limited-edition Hero Badge at designated redemption points. Admission is free; the Art Park is at 8 Museum Drive.

zh.headline: 西九藝術公園推出LEGO萬聖節英雄活動 免費入場至月底
zh.dek: 由今日至10月31日，小朋友可穿英雄裝扮參與拼砌工作坊、尋寶及萬聖節當晚壓軸任務，完成可換領限定勳章。
body: 西九文化區管理局與LEGO香港由10月15日起至31日，在藝術公園推出免費萬聖節主題活動。
主辦方形容搗蛋小怪獸「Brick-Monster」現身秘密花園。活動邀請小朋友穿上英雄服飾，帶備創意LEGO裝備，探索主題裝置、參與「BRICK or TRICK」工作坊、「Hero Hunt」、創意拼砌及表演。
萬聖節當晚有壓軸慶典，完成最終任務者可獲兌換券，前往指定地點換領限定英雄勳章。入場免費，地點為博物館道8號藝術公園。
